statement.excerpt: New concerns are emerging almost literally day,.

from_speaker: just in the last few days
our_interpretation: Read the apparent typo as 'almost daily,' consistent with the surrounding examples.

The plain reading is that distinct concerns about LLM harms were becoming publicly apparent on most days. A new concrete harmful application can count; an entirely new technical mechanism is not required.
Use March 3–10, 2023, the week leading into publication, to operationalize the ongoing observation and 'last few days.' Marcus supplied no exact reporting window.
Count distinct concerns, not repeated coverage of the same concern. Publication dates establish when concerns were publicly reported, not necessarily when the underlying behavior first occurred.
criteria.support_condition: A dated chronology shows distinct concerns or newly documented harmful applications appearing on most days during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive chronology shows only occasional new concerns, with the apparent daily flow consisting mainly of repetitions. Failure to find reports in an incomplete search is insufficient.
